title: Global Partners Opens New Headquarters at 275 Grove Street in Newton, Massachusetts
summary: New 125,000-square-foot space reflects the company's growth and sets the stage for its future Newton, Mass. (September 14, 2026) – Global Partners, a
body_markdown:
***New 125,000-square-foot space reflects the company’s growth and sets the stage for its future***


**** **Newton, Mass. (September 14, 2026) –** Global Partners, a leading independent liquid energy supplier and retail operator, celebrated the opening of its new corporate headquarters at 275 Grove Street in Newton, Massachusetts. The move marks a significant milestone for the company, bringing employees together in a modern, collaborative environment designed to support the way Global Partners works today and grows in the years ahead. The new headquarters occupies three floors of Building 3, offering 125,000 square feet of space, a 75 percent increase over the company’s previous footprint in Waltham. The office includes 38 conference rooms, three dedicated collaboration spaces and a stadium-style staircase connecting all three floors, along with coffee bars and gathering areas designed to encourage connection throughout the workday. The space also includes tailor-made areas for hosting customers and partners, reflecting Global’s commitment to strengthening relationships with the people it serves.


“This headquarters represents a major step forward for our company,” said Eric Slifka, President and Chief Executive Officer of Global Partners. “We set out to create a space that reflects who we are today, the quality of our people, the strength of the Global Spirit, and the ambition we have for the future. A tremendous amount of thought and investment went into every part of this building. From cutting-edge workspaces to tailor-made areas for hosting customers and partners, 275 Grove was designed to bring people together, encourage collaboration, and help us do our best work. It was designed to energize.”


275 Grove Street sits at the intersection of Interstate 95 and Massachusetts Turnpike, directly adjacent to Riverside Station on the MBTA Green Line, giving employees, customers and business partners convenient access from across New England. The site is also approximately 20 minutes from Logan International Airport and is surrounded by a wide range of restaurants, coffee shops and grocery stores.


“My hope is that our teammates feel that energy the moment they walk through the doors,” Slifka added, “and that this becomes a place they are proud to work, proud to share, and excited to help define. This headquarters is a reflection of what our people have helped build and what we are ready to build next.”


Beyond its collaborative workspaces, the new headquarters offers a range of amenities intended to support employees throughout the day, including:


- Coffee bars on each floor, open daily
- A snack wall available for purchase
- Kendal Kitchen at Riverside, offering fresh, made-to-order breakfast and lunch options in the building’s atrium
- A state-of-the-art fitness center, open 24/7 with employee badge access
- An on-site parking garage with more than 1,500 spaces for employees and visitors


Global designed the new headquarters not only to reflect its identity today, but to support its continued growth. As employees settle into the new office, the company looks forward to the collaboration, innovation and culture the new environment will help foster in the years to come.


**About Global Partners LP:**


*Building on a legacy that began more than 90 years ago, Global Partners has evolved into a Fortune 500 company and industry-leading integrated owner, supplier, and operator of liquid energy terminals, fueling locations, and guest-focused retail experiences. Global operates or maintains dedicated storage at 54 liquid energy terminals—with connectivity to strategic rail, pipeline, and marine assets—spanning from Maine to Florida and into the U.S. Gulf States. Through this extensive network, the company distributes gasoline, distillates, residual oil, and renewable fuels to wholesalers, retailers, and commercial customers. In addition, Global has a large portfolio of owned, leased and/or supplied retail locations across the Northeast states, the Mid-Atlantic, and Texas, providing the fuels people need to keep them on the go at their unique guest-focused convenience destinations. Recognized as one of Fortune’s Most Admired Companies, Global Partners is embracing progress and diversifying to meet the needs of the energy transition.*


*Global, a master limited partnership, trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol “GLP.” For additional information, visit *****[www.globalp.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.globalp.com&esheet=54105440&newsitemid=20240806720223&lan=en-US&anchor=www.globalp.com&index=2&md5=357274df387d0d2f3059aa9cd4196f95) ***.***
